text: In January 1943, he was found in an abandoned warehouse near King's Cross, seriously ill. He had eaten rat poison containing phosphorus, a paste smeared on crusts of bread. Whether he meant to end his life, or was simply starving, no one can say. He died in St Pancras Hospital. He was in his mid-thirties.
